tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po dbugs chen po zhes bya ba bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya bidya rā dzā shwa sa ma hā nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po dbugs chen po zhes bya ba sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la gling bzhi pa'i dbang phyug 'byung po'i bdag po chen po/ mche ba gtsigs pa ser skya zhes bya bas 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag ni 'byung po thams cad kyi bdag po lags te/ bdag ni gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na mchis pa'i 'byung po thams cad la 'tsho bar bgyid/ rdeg par bgyid/ 'ching bar bgyid/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nas 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du 'phen par bgyid pa/ yan lag dang nying lag rnams rnam par gcod par bgyid pa lags so// bcom ldan 'das gang gi tshe/ bdag bkres par gyur pa na/ dbugs gtong ste/ dbugs des gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu 'gengs par bgyid cing*/ bcom ldan 'das bdag mi dang mi ma lags pa thams cad kyi gzi byin 'phrog par bgyid pa lags te/ dbugs chen pos sems can rnams reg ma thag tu bro nad sna tshogs dag 'byung lags so// bcom ldan 'das gang na rig sngags kyi rgyal po dbugs chen po zhes bgyi ba 'di spyod pa der/ bdag gi dbugs kyis mi tshugs pa dang*/ 'byung po rnams 'tshe bar mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun rnams la phyag bgyis nas/ mgo 'am mgul du btags te/ 'chang ba der rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'i bro nad rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur bar bdag gis deng slan chad de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar yi dam 'tshal lags so// tadya thā/ ḍa ra ḍa ra/ ḍa ḍa ra ḍa ḍa ra/ tha ra tha ra/ thar tha ra thar tha ra/ ma ra ma ra/ ma ma ra ma ma ra/ hu dhu hu/ ha ha ha/ sa ra sa ra sa ra/

tsu tsu tsu/ bu bu bu/ ki li ki li ki li/ sarba bhu ta/ a dhi pa ti/ dra dra dra/ bra bra bra/ khu khu khu/ kra kra kra/ ya sa ya sa ya sa/ pāṇḍa re/ pāṇḍa re/ pāṇḍa re/ hu lu hu lu hu lu/ hu hu hu/ bdag la srungs shig /srungs shig /tsi li tsi li tsi li/ mi li mi li mi li/ kho sha kho sha kho sha/ gau rī gau rī gau rī/ bdag gi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ ma hā shwa swā hā/ ma hā bha ta/ a dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ gau rye swā hā/ u grā ya swā hā/ bdag bde legs su gyur cig /daṃ ṣṭi ka rā la piṃ ga la ā dzñā pa la ti swā hā/ 'phags pa rig sngags kyi rgyal po dbugs chen pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /rgya gar gyi mkhan po pra dzñā warma dang*/ zhu chen gyi lotstsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/// /
